description: Build Agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, with rich AI model and tool support on one collaborative workspace. Deploy on cloud, VPC, or self-hosted, so teams move from prototype to production without rebuilding the stack.
vibe: Monorepo discipline with scoped rules and zero tolerance for local test theater.
highlights: Scoped AGENTS.md files override root guidance based on the nearest file being edited.
Backend commands must be run through `uv run --project api` to ensure environment consistency.
Backend integration tests are explicitly CI-only, preventing wasted local cycles.
Docker env files are strictly partitioned: defaults in `.env.example`, optional settings in `docker/envs/*.env.example`.
assessment: This file demonstrates mature monorepo hygiene by delegating detailed rules to scoped AGENTS.md files, avoiding a monolithic instruction dump. The explicit CI-only test policy and strict env file separation show a team that values reproducibility and clear ownership boundaries over convenience. It is a model of pragmatic constraint-setting for large, multi-service repositories.
